source_name: Currency Research — Cash Cycle Seminar (ICCOS) EMEA/Europe
why_relevant: Premier global cash-management seminar series (EMEA edition Cape Town, 30 Nov - 2 Dec 2026). Central-bank cash departments and CIT operators speak; NBS/SK cash-cycle staff appearances would be direct evidence of who owns cash operations. No CEE-specific 2026 edition was found.

source_name: FinReport.sk — fintech/banking event coverage
why_relevant: SK financial trade outlet that reports conference sessions in detail (e.g. the first public debate on the National Fintech Strategy at Finweek Bratislava 2025), naming panellists and their titles. Efficient way to recover speaker rosters when organiser pages are taken down after an edition.

source_name: Startitup.sk / Nextech.sk — conference PR and recap articles
why_relevant: Tech/startup media that publish organiser-supplied pre-event PR listing confirmed speakers and their titles ahead of the official agenda page going live, plus recaps of Finweek and Profesia Days. Useful for early detection.

source_name: Top Slovak Fintech Awards (Zlata minca x FINAS)
why_relevant: Third/fourth-edition SK fintech award decided by a 31-member independent fintech jury (2025 winners FOAF, Doklado, Fumbi Network; 2024 Arbitas, Doklado, WageNow), presented at the Finweek gala. Jury composition and nominee lists map the active SK fintech/payments employer set and its people.

source_name: ÚVO – Vestník verejného obstarávania (Public Procurement Bulletin)
why_relevant: Statutory publication venue for all SK contracting-authority notices. Notices for banking/payment services (card acquiring, payment gateway, cash handling, core banking) name the buyer, the named contact person (kontaktná osoba) with function/e-mail/phone, and in award notices the winning supplier. This yields both buyer-side function owners and vendor org signals without any private-bank cooperation.

source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (tender search)
why_relevant: Structured search front-end over the bulletin; the practical entry point for repeatable filtered queries by CPV, contracting authority (SZRB, Eximbanka, Štátna pokladnica, Sociálna poisťovňa, Finančná správa, Slovenská pošta) and subject matter.

source_name: IS EVO / elektronická platforma (Úrad vlády SR)
why_relevant: EVO is the state e-procurement platform (administration moved to Úrad vlády SR on 31.3.2022). It routes ~45% of in-scope contracts and points to where tender documentation, Q&A and bidder identities live; the documentation (súťažné podklady) often contains the buyer's internal org chart and role names for payment operations.

source_name: JOSEPHINE / Eranet / Tendernet / EVOservis – private e-procurement platforms used by SK authorities
why_relevant: A large minority of SK tenders (JOSEPHINE ~22%, Eranet ~8% of e-procurement) are run outside EVO. Slovenská pošta runs its own Eranet instance (posta.eranet.sk). Missing these platforms means missing the tender documentation and bidder lists for state-linked financial actors.

source_name: TED / eNotices2 – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU), Slovakia filter
source_subtype: EU procurement database with open API/bulk data
why_relevant: Above-threshold SK notices are mirrored to TED with structured XML/eForms, including CPV 66110000 (banking services), 66172000 (financial transaction processing/clearing) and named contact points. TED is far more machine-friendly than ÚVO and gives cross-border visibility of who bids for SK payment-services contracts.

source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – Central Register of Contracts
why_relevant: All contracts of ministries, central bodies, public-law institutions and >50%-state-owned entities must be published here and only become effective the day after publication (Act 546/2010, §5a Act 211/2000). Contracts for payment gateways, card acquiring, cash logistics and core banking are therefore obtainable in full text, with signatories, prices and responsible-person names — a direct read on both buyer org structure and incumbent vendors. Notable exception: NBS is exempt.

source_name: Zmluvy.gov.sk – CRZ per-institution contract listings
why_relevant: Alternate CRZ front-end organised by institution (e.g. Slovenská pošta, a.s. listing), making per-actor contract monitoring simpler than the main CRZ search.

source_name: eGovZmluvy / zmluvy.egov.sk – municipal contract register (CRZ-linked)
why_relevant: Municipalities, VÚC and their organisations publish here; they are heavy buyers of card-acceptance and payment-gateway services (e.g. town of Trebišov's 'Zmluva o akceptácii platobných kariet'). Reveals which banks/PSPs win the long tail of SK public-sector acquiring and who signs on both sides.

source_name: UVOstat – aggregated ÚVO + CRZ data with API
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that joins tender notices, contract register and buyer↔supplier relationship graphs, with a documented API (free /api/subjekty tier, paid for the rest). Dramatically cheaper than scraping ÚVO directly and exposes supplier-concentration patterns that reveal vendor org footprints.

source_name: Verejnesutaze.sk – EPVO/EKS/ÚVO tender aggregator
why_relevant: Consolidates notices from EPVO, EKS and ÚVO into one searchable feed with alerting; useful as a cross-check that no payment-services tender was missed across the fragmented platform landscape.

source_name: Národný katalóg otvorených dát – ÚVO datasets (data.slovensko.sk)
why_relevant: Official open-data catalogue entry listing ÚVO's published datasets — the legitimate bulk route into bulletin data, avoiding scraping and bot defences.

source_name: SZRB – Vedenie banky (Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka leadership page)
why_relevant: State-owned bank's own published predstavenstvo (management board) and dozorná rada (supervisory board) roster — primary evidence of leadership moves. Current listing shows Radko Kuruc as chairman/GR, Daniela Klučková as supervisory-board chair. Changes here are driven by MF SR shareholder decisions, giving early warning of political-cycle turnover.

source_name: EXIMBANKA SR – Vedenie (leadership page)
why_relevant: Export-import bank's own board roster. Leadership is appointed/dismissed by the government (vláda SR) on MF SR proposal, so this page is the authoritative post-change record; recent turnover (Janočko → Podhorec, plus deputy GR Milan Horváth and board member Igor Lichnovský) shows high churn and confirms it as a live A5 signal.

source_name: MF SR – organizácie s účasťou štátu / výkon akcionárskych práv (SZRB, Eximbanka)
source_subtype: ministry portal / shareholder disclosures + press releases
why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance is the shareholder/founder for SZRB and Eximbanka and the budget chapter owner for Štátna pokladnica and Finančná správa. Its pages enumerate the state-linked financial actors in scope and its press releases announce leadership changes (e.g. 'Nové vedenie Štátnej pokladnice'). This is the canonical actor-map pointer for the whole cell.

source_name: Štátna pokladnica – Štatút a Organizačný poriadok ŠP
source_subtype: statute / internal organizational rules published as PDF
why_relevant: The Treasury publishes both its statute and its full organizačný poriadok as PDFs, naming the management tiers (riaditeľ ŠP → riaditeľ odboru → vedúci oddelenia) and the departments that own payment operations and client accounts. Dated versions (2023, 2025) allow direct diffing of organization changes over time — an unusually explicit A5 signal.

source_name: Štátna pokladnica – Osobitné podmienky pre poskytovanie služieb platobnej brány ŠP
why_relevant: The Treasury operates its own payment gateway for public-sector clients and publishes its terms and pricing. These documents identify the technical/processing arrangement behind SK public-sector e-payments and the ŠP unit that owns it — directly relevant to who the function owners are and which vendors sit underneath.

source_name: Finančná správa SR – Organizačný poriadok FR SR (Predstavitelia document series)
source_subtype: internal organizational rules published as dated PDFs
why_relevant: FR SR publishes its full organizational rules in a dated document folder (at least two 2025 editions: 2025.04.09 and 2025.11.07), setting out internal units, management authority and responsibilities. Frequent re-issues make this a high-resolution organization-change tracker for the largest state financial-administration body, and the '/Predstavitelia/' path also carries leadership documents.

source_name: Sociálna poisťovňa – Organizačná štruktúra a Generálny riaditeľ
why_relevant: Sociálna poisťovňa publishes its org structure and a dedicated GR page; the GR is appointed/dismissed by the government, so changes are politically driven and well-signalled. It is also one of SK's largest originators of mass payment flows (benefits disbursement), making its payment-operations units and their tenders commercially significant.

source_name: Slovenská pošta – Verejné obstarávanie / profil obstarávateľa
why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is the physical distribution arm of the postal-banking nexus (historic Poštová banka relationship, cash deposits/withdrawals at post offices). Its own procurement profile lists above-threshold contracts and, since 1.8.2021, routes them via posta.eranet.sk. Its tenders for cash handling, counter systems and payment terminals name incumbent suppliers and buyer-side owners.

source_name: CISŠS – Register výberových konaní v štátnej službe
why_relevant: Central statutory registry of civil-service selection procedures, published at least 15 working days before the procedure. For Finančná správa, Štátna pokladnica and ministry units this is the cleanest hiring/jobs signal in the cell — vacancy titles disclose new or restructured units (e.g. payment-operations, eKasa, IT platform roles) before any org chart is republished.

source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) – Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR
why_relevant: Any vendor contracting with the SK state above thresholds must register its beneficial owners and its authorised person (oprávnená osoba). For payment/banking suppliers this exposes ownership chains, group structure and the responsible verifying party — an indirect but authoritative read on vendor organization changes, and it links directly to who wins ÚVO/CRZ contracts.

source_name: Teraz.sk / TASR + SITA Financie – state-bank appointment reporting
why_relevant: TASR (teraz.sk) and SITA reliably report government appointments to SZRB/Eximbanka boards on the day of the vláda session, usually before the institution updates its own site. Serves as the low-latency trigger for re-checking primary pages, and supplies the outgoing name (important for tracking where executives move to).

source_name: INEKO – Hodnotenie formálnej nezávislosti inštitúcií (Finančné riaditeľstvo profile)
why_relevant: Think-tank database documenting appointment/dismissal mechanics, tenure and turnover of heads of SK state institutions. Gives the structural rules (who appoints whom, for how long) that let you anticipate leadership churn rather than only observe it.

source_name: Zastavme korupciu / Nadácia + investigative desks on state-entity tenders
why_relevant: Anti-corruption NGO and investigative outlets (SME Index, Pravda) analyse specific state-entity tenders — e.g. a Slovenská pošta tender challenged for specification steering — and in doing so name incumbent suppliers, decision-makers and the internal units that ran the procurement. Useful for interpreting an award that the formal record leaves opaque.
